scope: Read-only source evidence; benchmark has not yet been executed. Verify exact benchmark RTS source hashes before applying these identities.

semantics.heapOccupiedBytes: PartitionedHeap.occupied_size; includes allocated garbage and active evacuation copies.
semantics.totalAllocationBytes: occupied_size - evacuated_size + reclaimed_size; counts allocation, not current live retention.
semantics.reclaimedBytes: Cumulative reclaim accounting, including all workload and GC garbage, not only prepared keys.
semantics.derivedEvacuationCopyBytes: heapOccupiedBytes - (totalAllocationBytes - reclaimedBytes); zero alone does not prove Phase::Pause.
semantics.maxObservedPostGcHeapBytes: Historical maximum occupied dynamic heap at recorded GC stops; not current live bytes and not necessarily an exact live maximum.
semantics.gcTrigger: One forced bounded incremental_gc call after replying without Candid allocation; may start, advance or finish a cycle.
semantics.gcPhaseCounter: No public Prim exposes authoritative current incremental phase or completed collection count.
semantics.wasmMemoryBytes: Allocated Wasm linear-memory capacity, a high-water allocation, not reclaimable live heap.
